bestBets.overview: If the BOM can be relied upon, enough rain can fall on Wednesday for this track to remain soft. Kick the eight race card off with a 1980m C2. No's 1,2,6,8 likely to settle forward. THINKING GOLD looks to be the testing material, close up in strong grade latest two. ROSSO LEVANTO has put together two decent efforts to commence this campaign, like its fight. EMPIRE OF ART didn't get a fair look fresh, looking back on its career 2nd-up this distance is not of concern.

raceTips.comment: ROSSO LEVANTO was a winner when resuming over 1400m at Eagle Farm and was beaten only half a length when stepping out to 1650m second up. At peak fitness, she looks ideally placed with the rise to this distance. THINKING GOLD has performed well in all three runs for the new stable. The blinkers come off, the step up in trip will suit and he should find this easier. EMPRESS ASPEN proved too good over 1890m two runs back and was just outgunned late last time at 2160m. She’s hard fit and gets in well with the claim. EMPIRE OF ART closed off strongly to finish a length away in fourth when resuming over the mile at Doomben. He strips fitter and will relish the rise journey.

bestBets.overview: 800m BM65. Nos 5,7,8,9 provide the speed, maybe 10 as well, maybe not. MEDALS resumes, proven fresh, lumped 62.5 to success just two starts ago. YOWERI fit and well, sure to be a doing a rain dance.  RUNAROUND SUE strips fitter, draws best of the speed and is proven around here  -  Track+Distance: 6:2:1:1. MR WANDJI is two from three at Ipswich but both over 1350m. Would appear that Pat Webster holds the aces.

raceTips.comment: MEDALS returns to the races. He boasts a strong first up record and the 800m kick off looks ideal. He gets in well with the 3kg claim and the draws to get the right run. RUNAROUND SUE just had one get the better of her late when resuming over 870 at Toowoomba. She holds a strong second up record and will take catching from the inside draw. YOWERI is in top form having won three of his past four starts. He’s untried over this shorter trip but I think it’ll suit. TARA’S REWARD weakened late when resuming at the Sunshine Coast. He’s fitter for the run and the drop to 800m looks ideal.

bestBets.overview: 1350m Maiden Hcp. Light on for natural pace, that should see no's 6,8,11 settle up there race run to suit. The resuming I AM LOUIE looks to be the one to beat. Ran on very well on debut in town, beaten margin wasn't an accurate guide to the performance. SPIRIT OF LOUIS had support when debuting in town four weeks ago. The alley cools my jets.  PROPHET OF DESTINY caught the eye latest, dismayed to see 'them' once again stretch him out beyond 1200m. Three fails from three attempts leading in to this. WELCOME ADVICE new blood resuming for a stable very good in these situations.  One of two Ben Thompson will be aboard, he's good but that's an ask! CAUTIONARY TALE maps well,  not the worst.

raceTips.comment: WELCOME ADVICE resumes for the new stable. She failed to fire in two Sydney runs but the form around her is solid and she’s sure to find this easier. She’s pleased in two recent trials and draws to get the right run. I AM LOUIE returns He showed promise in his first preparation and was unlucky not to have won at his second start. The 1350m kick off will suit. KAIDA ODORA has been placed in three of her four starts and looks nearing a win. Beaten only a head last time over 1400m at Dalby, she can make her presence felt here. PROPHET OF DESTINY comes off a much improved effort to finish second at Eagle Farm. He’s fit and should find this slightly easier.

bestBets.overview: 1350m F&M 0-58. No's 1,3,8,11 most likely make the pace. One of those races where nothing can win, sure as eggs something will! When in doubt often the market proves to be the best guide but right now I would prefer to to give this race a complete miss.  The most in-form runner is SECRET ROSE. Just so happens to be the widest drawn. Conversely IF you can forgive  VOSTOKOVA one run it maps to be the one. FIERY LASS an in-form runner, just not sure how much goes its way in transit.

raceTips.comment: VOSTOKOVA had been racing well prior to her latest, where she failed to fire in the heavy conditions and was found to be in season. Back on a fairer surface, she’s suited over this trip and draws to get the right run. TARTAN TIGER has had no luck at her past starts over the longer journey. The drop back to 1350m will suit and the low draw will see her enjoy a kind run in transit. HEART ‘N’ POWER wasn’t far away last start in stronger company over this course and distance. She’ll find this easier but will need a touch of luck from the wide gate. FIERY LASS comes off a strong maiden win over 1300m at the Sunshine Coast. She’s clearly settled in well since joining the new yard and can figure again.

bestBets.overview: 1100m  Maiden Hcp. Note just a dozen can run hence there's twice as many emergencies as in 'The Cup'. ONCE AGAIN eight emergencies rarely guarantees a capacity field. Here just eight remain. Now three will be on debut and two will be returning from a spell.  The resuming RECONCILIATE has been prepped for this with two recent trials, finishing 2nd and 1st respectively.   1st-up last time in had all favours finishing 2nd at $31.00. Had excuses both prior to going out for a spell. Tempo and/or tactics related. The newcomers ANDERLAY and ANGELEO draw suitably and bring positive trial form to the table.

raceTips.comment: RECONCILIATE makes her return and she did show promise in her first campaign. She impressed in her two recent trials and the 1100m kick off will suit. SNITZSTREAM bumped into a handy one last start at the Sunshine Coast but she did hold a three length margin back to the rest. The 2kg claim sees her in nicely, she will just need a touch of luck from a tricky gate. ANDERLAY makes her debut. She’s trialled up nicely and looks to do everything right. The 2kg claim is a plus and she draws ideally. MAGIC INVADER has been placed on six occasions and is certainly capable. He pulled up with cardiac arrythmia after failing to figure first up and can bounce back here.

bestBets.overview: 1100m 0-60, but only for the blokes. Bit going on early, map says nos 2,6,11,13,14 are the speed but suggests no's 3,4,9,10 might be willing as well. CITY GOLD FIELD landed good bets and won well fresh then was a tad disappointing 2nd-up when sent to town. Drawn awkardly. PUROSANGUE resumes with the benefit of two trials to focus the mind, The map looks ideal, in a very much in-form yard just now. SIGLO DE ORO is racing well, alley the concern. FLYING VENTO may not have beaten much but all you can do is win, upside. Either LA PROFECIA went too slow in front last start and nodded off, or is weak. Should find out today. Wary of the resuming NINE MILL. Form-lines from debut win stack up.

raceTips.comment: FLYING VENTO comes off a dominant debut win over 1000m at Casino. Very raw in the straight, he will have taken plenty on improvement from the experience. He does rise in grade but the extra 100m will suit and the winkers go on. NINE MILL proved too good on debut at Lismore before a break. He looked sharp in a recent Gold Coast trial and the draws to get the gun run. LA PROFECIA was a winner here three starts back but has felt the pinch late in two subsequent runs. Back to 1100m, the blinkers go on and Ryan Maloney will steer from a good gate. PUROSANGUE resumes. He’s won two of four first up appearances and looks ready to go off two solid trials.

bestBets.overview: 1100m 0-60 for the fairer sex. No's 2,3,4,8,9 most likely to be the frontrunners.  LADY MILAN hard and fit, invariably thereabouts. As predicted MERCATELLO was aiming too high when resuming, strips fitter for that and finds herself in a realistic assignment this time. Maps well as well. MAGIC MOZ was specked at odds when deuting here. Resumes today with a recent trial win to respect.  MISS ZERMATT freshedne, takes a claim, include if appearing fancied.

raceTips.comment: MAGIC MOZ resumes. She’s just had the one start and it was a commanding victory over 1100m at Toowoomba. She looked good winning a recent Dalby trial and if she jumps away clean, she’ll take beating. LADY MILAN scored a dominant maiden win over 800m here two runs back and was solid fishing third last time when up in grade. She does race well here and with even luck from the wide gate, she can figure. MERCATELLO weakened late when resuming in stronger company. Back in grade, she strips fitter and can certainly figure. MISS ZERMATT was a narrow runner up over this track and trip two runs back but didn’t have a lot go her way last time at Grafton. Freshened, she gets in well with the claim and draws to get the right run.

bestBets.overview: 1350m 0-58. A 'no pace race' on paper, map is taking long odds-on that 13 leads, reckons no's  2 & 3  settle closest in transit. Matthew Dunn is good for two, both look to be decent hopes. THE TORQUE XPRESS 4th run in, can be winning in this 'weak affair'. TSUNUKI could be his best hope, mapping so well for Jake Bayliss. BEE EXACT drops back to a realistic assignment, no doubt Bella Youngberry will be on the move when them gates fly. Plan B would be an awful watch. CLUBHOUSE is invariably thereabouts, can be again.

raceTips.comment: THE TORQUE EXPRESS has failed to figure in three runs back this campaign but is sure to find this easier. He’s fit and has won here previously. TSUNUKI comes here off his debut win over 1250m at Ballina. This is a rise in grade but he’ll be better for the experience and the extra 100m will suit. CHANGE THE DEEL won well when resuming over 1200m and charged home from the tail last time to claim a narrow third over 1300m. He may be looking for more ground now but he’s racing well and will be strong late. BEE EXACT has been racing well but just struggled last time against stronger opposition. Back in grade, he can bounce back but he does have to overcome the wide gate.
